desc: four-band false colour for filming bigfoot

params.name: edges
params.help: slides the four cuts through the tones — carve the shadows fine or the highlights

params.name: hue
params.help: spins all four band colours around the wheel together

params.name: fold
params.help: each band folds back on itself — ramps at 0, full solarized tents at 1

params.name: steep
params.help: contrast inside each band — flat posters up to hard metallic ramps
